prompt: A square napkin measures $10$ cm on each side. A circle of diameter $10$ cm is printed on it, touching all four sides. How much of the napkin is left UNPRINTED, in square centimeters, rounded to the nearest tenth?
hint: Unprinted area $=$ square area $-$ circle area.

hints.text: Unprinted area $=$ square area $-$ circle area.
The square is $10 \times 10 = 100$. The circle has diameter $10$, so its radius is $5$ and its area is $25\pi$.

explanation: The circle touches all four sides, so its diameter is $10$ and its radius is $5$: area $= \pi(5)^2 = 25\pi \approx 78.5$ sq cm.
Subtract: $100 - 78.5 = 21.5$ sq cm in the four corners. Choice A.

alternativeExplanations.title: Eyeball the corners
steps: The circle nearly fills the napkin, leaving only four small corner scraps.
Those scraps should be a small slice of the $100$ sq cm total — around a fifth — so $21.5$ fits and $78.5$ (choice C, the circle itself) clearly does not.
